title: Soil
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names ways of playing with soil and the safe rules: never eat it or throw it, wash hands after.

floor.question: Is this stone rough or smooth?

steps: Name ways to play with soil.

board.do: Draw a child filling a can with soil.

board.say: What must she do after playing?

board.do: Wait for the child to say wash her hands.

misconceptions.ask: Is it good to play with soil?
misconceptions.repair: Play with soil in class, then wash hands together. Say: play, then wash.

misconceptions.ask: Can we eat soil while playing?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of germs and worms in soil. Rule: soil never goes in the mouth.

misconceptions.ask: You played with dry soil. Should you wash your hands?
misconceptions.repair: Rub hands after dry soil play on white paper. See the dust.

misconceptions.ask: Is throwing soil at a friend a good way to play?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about soil in the eyes. Agree games where soil stays on the ground.

checks.question: Name one way to play with soil.
checks.answer: Fill and empty cans (model, draw in it)
